temperature.intended_purpose: Sampling temperature for answer generation; candidate values and baseline pending team definition

chunk_overlap.intended_purpose: Token overlap between adjacent document chunks in RAG indexing; candidate values and baseline pending team definition

similarity_metric.intended_purpose: Vector distance metric used for RAG embedding retrieval; supported metric set and baseline pending team definition

quantization.intended_purpose: Weight quantization format for 1B Ollama model; supported candidate set and baseline pending team definition

model.description: Exact 1B Ollama model artifact pending definition

chunk_size.description: RAG chunk size in tokens pending definition

max_context_tokens.description: Maximum context window in tokens pending definition

max_new_tokens.description: Maximum generated tokens per response pending definition

rag_corpus.description: Exact RAG knowledge corpus identifier or path pending definition

answer_quality.intended_purpose: Application quality metric evaluated against reference answers (direction: maximize). Tutor + RAG output.

latency_ms.intended_purpose: Real Tutor application end-to-end latency in milliseconds (direction: minimize). Do NOT confuse Tutor latency with gem5 simulated execution time.

baseline.message: Software baseline is draft / pending definition. Confirmed architecture: 1B Ollama + RAG. Unresolved fields must be specified before execution.
